rationale: The retrieved evidence records do not support a new optimization for this workflow. The first evidence (experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2, pattern P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE) demonstrates adding pip dependency caching to a Python workflow, but this Cypress/Node.js workflow already implements equivalent npm caching via actions/cache@v3 with a key based on package-lock.json and restore-keys. The other retrieved evidence records cover Bazel-specific dependency cache evaluation (P-LIT-BAZEL-DEPS, not applicable to this Node.js project) and synthetic unused-dependency skipping experiments (P-LIT-UNUSED-DEP-SKIP) which require separate selection policies and have contraindications around transitive/lockfile changes. No retrieved evidence supports adding timeouts, cancel-stale, or matrix restructuring for this workflow. Since the primary caching optimization is already present and no other retrieved evidence applies, no change is warranted.
